definitions.gloss: view; prospect; outlook; scenery from a high point
definitions.explanation: The view or panorama visible from an elevated or open location. Emphasizes the breadth and quality of what can be seen.

examples.english: The view is great from here.

examples.japanese: ⟦{丘|おか}→丘：02183_oka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{見晴|みは}らし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: We enjoyed the view from the top of the hill.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧{見晴|みは}らし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧よい⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧です。
examples.english: This room has a nice view overlooking the ocean.

notes:
{見晴|みは}らし is derived from the verb {見晴|みは}らす (to look out over, to command a view). It refers to the quality or extent of a panoramic view, especially from an elevated or open position.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見晴|みは}らし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: to have a good/open view
- {見晴|みは}らし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: to have a poor/obstructed view
- {見晴|みは}らし{台|だい}: observation deck, lookout point
- {見晴|みは}らし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧よい⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: a place with a good view

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧: scenery, landscape (general term)
- ⟦{眺|なが}め→眺め：03502_nagame⟧: view, vista (what you see when looking)
- {見晴|みは}らし: view quality from a vantage point (emphasizes openness and scope)

USAGE:
{見晴|みは}らし{台|だい} is commonly used as a place name for viewpoints in parks, hiking trails, and tourist areas throughout Japan.
